en.机关把生成元写在词的右侧：g → gr 或 gs。顶点上的作用为 (k,m)·x: Append generators on the right: g → gr or gs. On vertices, (k,m)·x = k + (−1)^m x modulo n. In a composite map, the rightmost map acts first.
en.固定一个顶点的元素组成稳定子 H；gH 与顶点 g·0 一一对应。固定一个点并不: The elements fixing a vertex form its stabilizer H. Cosets gH correspond bijectively to vertices g·0. Fixing one vertex does not mean fixing every vertex.
en.Q / E 只改变观察方向。金色镜门只有沿指定视线重合时才能穿越；穿越执行 s，: Q / E changes only the view. Golden mirror gates can be crossed only when aligned along their marked sightline. Crossing applies s; rotating the camera is not a group operation.
en.所有求和都在 GF(2) 中进行。校验矩阵 H 的第 i 列是 i 的三位二进制: All sums are in GF(2). Column i of the parity-check matrix H is the three-bit binary form of i. Parity positions are 1, 2, 4; data positions are 3, 5, 6, 7.
en.综合征 s = Hrᵀ。至多一位出错时，非零综合征给出错误所在的列；不附加错误数: The syndrome is s = Hrᵀ. With at most one error, a nonzero syndrome identifies its column. Without a bound on the error count, the syndrome does not identify a unique error pattern.
en.Hamming(7,4) 的最小距离为 3；增加整体偶校验后最小距离为 4。扩展: Hamming(7,4) has minimum distance 3; adding overall even parity raises it to 4. The extended code corrects one error and detects two. Equidistant candidates cannot be uniquely decoded without further evidence.
en.绕行四次，再穿镜两次，回到单位元: Rotate four times, cross twice, return to the identity
en.按序访问 r、r²、r³、e、s、e。镜门上的罗马数字给出对齐视角；两层回廊分别: Visit r, r², r³, e, s, e in order. Align mirror gates to their Roman-numeral view. The two galleries represent rotations and reflections.
en.分别构造 rs 与 sr，比较整个顶点排列: Construct rs and sr separately; compare all vertex images
en.先按 r、s 操作并提交，庭院会保留第一份排列。第二次从 e 出发按 s、r 操: Apply r then s and submit to keep the first permutation. Start again at e and apply s then r. The same generators can lead to different endpoints.
en.遍历顶点轨道，封存所有固定顶点 0 的元素: Explore the vertex orbit; seal every element fixing vertex 0
en.行走时观察 0 的像。只有抵达的群元素才能封存；收集完整轨道，再比较固定一个顶点: Watch the image of 0 as you walk. Only reached elements can be sealed. Explore the full orbit, then distinguish fixing one vertex from fixing the whole figure.
en.为四个左陪集各选一个代表，旋转与反射各两枚: Choose one representative per left coset: two rotations and two reflections
en.H 是顶点 0 的稳定子。两个代表若把 0 送到同一点，就属于同一个左陪集；在两: H stabilizes vertex 0. Representatives sending 0 to the same vertex belong to the same left coset. Distribute your choices across both galleries.
en.封存全部旋转，再构造 srs 验证共轭: Seal all rotations, then construct srs to test conjugation
en.第一阶段找出旋转子群的全部元素。第二阶段从 e 出发构造 srs，观察它仍在旋转: First identify every element of the rotation subgroup. Then start from e and construct srs. Check that it remains a rotation and compare it with the inverse of r.
en.构造稳定子，再找出共轭离开它的证据: Build the stabilizer, then find a conjugate outside it
en.先封存固定顶点 0 的全部元素；提交后从 e 出发构造 rsr⁻¹，检验它是否还: Seal all elements fixing vertex 0. Submit, then construct rsr⁻¹ from e. Does it still fix vertex 0?
en.遍历八个元素，找出对两组对顶点都无影响的核: Visit all eight elements; find the kernel fixing both opposite-vertex pairs
en.只观察集合 {0,2} 和 {1,3}。允许集合内部交换，但两个集合都必须保持各: Observe only {0,2} and {1,3}. Swaps within a pair are allowed, but both pairs must remain individually unchanged. This kernel differs from a single-vertex stabilizer.
en.给出四个商类代表，再验证非平凡交换子: Find four quotient representatives, then a nonidentity commutator
en.在 D₆ 中令 N = ⟨r²⟩。先按 (k mod 2,m) 区分四个商类；再: In D₆ let N = ⟨r²⟩. Use (k mod 2,m) to distinguish four quotient classes. Then construct rsr⁻¹s from e: it belongs to N but is not the identity.
en.保留消息 1011，点亮三座校验信标: Keep message 1011; set the three parity beacons
en.信息位已经锁定。切换视角观察三组校验拱线，再决定位置 1、2、4 的取值；所有校: Data bits are locked. Rotate to inspect the three parity channels, then choose values at positions 1, 2, 4. Every check must have even parity.
en.只重建位置 3 与 5，恢复有效码字: Rebuild only positions 3 and 5 to recover a codeword
en.问号表示已知位置的擦除，不是未知位置的翻转。把两个未知比特代入三个校验方程，保留: A question mark is an erasure at a known position, not an unknown-position flip. Solve the three parity equations for the two unknown bits; preserve the other five.
en.在一次修改内修复收到的七位信号: Repair the received seven-bit signal with one change
en.这次信道保证恰有一位错误。观察三组校验结果，把综合征与 H 的列比较；发送的消息: The channel guarantees exactly one error. Compare the three check results with H’s columns. The original message is not shown.
en.连续修复两次独立的单比特错误: Repair two independent single-bit errors in sequence
en.第一束信号修复后提交，第二束会使用另一条消息和另一处错误。每一段只有一次修改机会: Submit the repaired first signal. The second uses a different message and error position. Each stage allows only one change.
en.构造非零码字，用恰好三座灯证明距离上界: Build a nonzero codeword of weight three as an upper-bound witness
en.从全零码字出发，寻找三列相加为零的组合。H 没有零列且没有重复列，因此重量 1、: Start at zero and find three H columns summing to zero. H has no zero or repeated columns, ruling out nonzero codewords of weight one or two.
en.修复扩展码的一位错误，兼顾整体奇偶: Repair one extended-code error using overall parity
en.第八位是整体偶校验，不属于 H 的前三行。综合征为零而整体为奇数时，错误可能在第: Bit eight gives overall even parity and is absent from H’s first three rows. Zero syndrome with odd total parity can mean an error at bit eight. At most one error is guaranteed.
en.封存两个不同的有效码字，它们都距接收词两位: Seal two distinct codewords, both two bits from the received word
en.本关有两位错误。不要猜哪条消息才是真的；从接收词出发，分别构造两个距离为 2 的: There are two errors. Do not guess the original message. Construct two valid extended codewords at distance two from the received word to prove decoding is ambiguous.
en.先完成扩展编码，再在一错信道中恢复消息: Encode an extended word, then recover it through one-error noise
en.先为消息 1101 补齐四个校验位。提交后信道将翻转一位；第二阶段结合综合征和整: Complete the four parity bits for message 1101. After submission the channel flips one bit. Combine the syndrome and overall parity to decode.
en.证据尚不完整。检查目标、封存记录与行动预算。: Evidence is incomplete. Check the goal, sealed records and action budget.
en.用刚才的结构，完成验证: Verify the structure you just built
en.先对齐对应视角，再点击信标切换 0 / 1。: Align the marked view, then click the beacon to toggle 0 / 1.
en.封存当前抵达的元素，再行走寻找其他证据。再次封存同一元素可取消。: Seal the current element, then explore further. Sealing it again removes it.
en.只有距离接收词两位的有效码字才能封存。保留第一份证据，再恢复接收词寻找第二份。: Only valid codewords at distance two can be sealed. Keep the first, then restore the received word to find the second.
en.机关把生成元写在词的右侧。镜门切换旋转层与反射层；相机只改变视线，不改变当前的群: Append generators on the right. Mirror gates switch rotation and reflection galleries. The camera changes only the view. Compare rs and sr by starting each experiment at e.
en.观察旅人沿下层回廊走向 r，同时查看顶点排列。: Watch the traveler follow the lower gallery to r and inspect the vertex images.
en.两扇金色镜门沿这一条视线重合；相机变化不会写入路径词。: The golden gates overlap along this sightline. Camera motion adds nothing to the path word.
en.现在穿越到上层，得到 rs。右乘的顺序记录在手记中。: Cross to the upper gallery to obtain rs. The notes record the order of right multiplication.
en.提交后从 e 重新出发。正式关卡需要你继续构造 sr，比较两个完整排列。: Submit and start again at e. In the real puzzle, construct sr and compare the two full permutations.
en.这个独立例子保证只有一位错误。综合征等于 H 中错误位置的列；先定位，再对齐信标: This independent example has exactly one error. The syndrome equals the erroneous column of H. Locate it, align the beacon, then verify every check.
en.综合征为二进制 010。H 的第二列是 010，因此观察第二座信标。: The syndrome is binary 010. Column two of H is 010, so inspect beacon two.
en.翻转这一位。综合征归零；在至多一错的前提下，有效码字被唯一恢复。: Flip this bit. The syndrome becomes zero. Under the one-error bound, the valid codeword is uniquely recovered.
en.校验方程与距离条件同时满足，桥梁可以接通。: Both parity equations and distance conditions hold; the bridge can connect.
en.先对齐至{0}侧，再操作这一机关。: Align view {0} before operating this mechanism.
en.通过手札或实体机关操作；Q / E 对齐视角后才能穿镜或切换信标。封存证据后提交: Use the notes or physical mechanisms. Align with Q / E before crossing mirrors or toggling beacons. Seal evidence, then submit.
en.提交前须访问全部群元素。: Visit every group element before submitting.
en.r⁴ = s² = e。关系式描述的是整个顶点排列恢复，而不是旅人碰巧回到相同的: r⁴ = s² = e restores the entire vertex permutation, rather than merely returning to the same screen position.
en.在 D₄ 中，rs ≠ sr。右乘依次记录的两个词可以用它们对顶点的不同作用来区: In D₄, rs ≠ sr. Distinguish the right-appended words by their different actions on vertices.
en.轨道—稳定子定理：|D₄| = |Orb(0)|·|Stab(0)| = 4·2: Orbit–stabilizer: ∣D₄∣ = ∣Orb(0)∣·∣Stab(0)∣ = 4·2. A fixed vertex can still allow a nonidentity reflection.
en.令 H = Stab(0)。gH = hH 当且仅当 g·0 = h·0；每个顶: Let H = Stab(0). Then gH = hH iff g·0 = h·0. Each vertex corresponds to a left coset; choose one representative per coset.
en.C₄ = ⟨r⟩ 是正规子群：r 保持它，srs = r⁻¹ 也保持它。r、s: C₄ = ⟨r⟩ is normal: r preserves it and srs = r⁻¹ stays inside it. Since r and s generate D₄, every conjugation preserves C₄.
en.H = {e,s} 不是正规子群。rsr⁻¹ = r²s，把顶点 0 送到 2，: H = {e,s} is not normal. The conjugate rsr⁻¹ = r²s sends 0 to 2, so it lies outside H.
en.对两个对顶点集合的作用，其核为 {e,r²,s,r²s}。这些元素分别保持两组集: The action on opposite-vertex pairs has kernel {e,r²,s,r²s}. These elements preserve each pair as a set while possibly exchanging its vertices.
en.N = ⟨r²⟩ 在 D₆ 中阶为 3，指数为 4。商群中 r 与 s 的像交换: In D₆, N = ⟨r²⟩ has order 3 and index 4. Images of r and s commute in the quotient, but rsr⁻¹s = r² is not the identity in D₆.
en.校验式：c₁+c₃+c₅+c₇=0，c₂+c₃+c₆+c₇=0，c₄+c₅+c₆: Parity equations: c₁+c₃+c₅+c₇=0, c₂+c₃+c₆+c₇=0, c₄+c₅+c₆+c₇=0. All three equations hold in GF(2).
en.已知擦除位置时，只需求出相应列的未知系数。H 的任意两列线性无关，所以两处擦除可: For known erasure positions, solve for the unknown coefficients of their columns. Every pair of H columns is independent, so two erasures have a unique recovery.
en.显示的综合征按 H 的三行从上到下排列，对应权重 1、2、4。假设至多一错，它就: The displayed syndrome follows H’s rows from top to bottom, with weights 1, 2, 4. Under the one-error assumption it is the column of the error position.
en.每段接力各有独立的一错假设。第一段的错误位置不会限制第二段；每次都必须重新计算综: Each relay has its own one-error assumption. The first error position does not constrain the second. Recompute the syndrome every time.
en.线性码的最小距离等于非零码字的最小重量。三列之和为零给出重量 3 的码字；无零列: A linear code’s minimum distance is its least nonzero weight. Three columns summing to zero give weight 3; no zero or repeated columns rules out weights 1 and 2.
en.在至多两错的假设下：整体为奇数表示一错；综合征为零则错误在第八位。整体为偶数且综: Assuming at most two errors: odd overall parity means one error; zero syndrome places it at bit eight. Even overall parity with nonzero syndrome indicates two errors: detect, without unique correction.
en.两个候选分别距同一接收词 2 位，证明半径 2 的译码球相交。最小距离 4 不足: Two candidates each two bits from one received word prove radius-two decoding balls overlap. Minimum distance 4 cannot guarantee unique correction of two errors.
en.先用冗余约束构造码字，再用错误数假设解释综合征。校验通过与译码唯一是两个不同结论: First use redundancy constraints to encode, then use the error bound to interpret the syndrome. Passing parity checks and unique decoding are different conclusions.

ja.机关把生成元写在词的右侧：g → gr 或 gs。顶点上的作用为 (k,m)·x: 生成元を右に追加：g → gr または gs。頂点への作用は (k,m)·x = k + (−1)^m x（mod n）。合成では右の写像が先に作用します。
